name: Health Sciences Authority

scam_info.sample: The first fake account, with the username ‘hsa_sg’, has put up videos on HSA’s tobacco enforcement actions and vaccine approvals. The other fake account, with the username ‘hsasingaporeofficial’
scam_info.notes: One of 3 fake-HSA-account alerts (all migrated legacy pages): fake TikTok (19 Oct 2022: hsa_sg, hsasingaporeofficial), fake Instagram (14 Sep 2022: hsa_sg, hsa.gov.sg; /announcements/hsa-alerts-on-fake-hsa-instagram-accounts/), fake Facebook (/announcements/fake-hsa-account-on-facebook/, not opened). Also /announcements/fake-hsa-laboratory-report-used-to-promote-a-health-supplement-online/ (not opened). Pages say HSA then had no TikTok/Instagram; current site footer links https://www.instagram.com/hsa.singapore/ as official.

scam_info.sample: The three products are: Product name | Potent ingredients | ‘Coco Curv’ | Sibutramine – banned in Singapore | ‘Choco Fit’ | ...
scam_info.notes: HSA 'Announcements' (2,115 URLs in sitemap) include ~263 illegal/adulterated health-product alerts (URL keyword hsa-alert|illegal|undeclared|adulterat|banned|potent; 102 start 'hsa-alert'). Each names products (entity_name = PRODUCT names, sometimes seller channels: 'sold on local e-commerce platforms such as Shopee and Qoo10, or social media platforms such as Facebook and Instagram'); usually no seller URLs. Product photos in PDF annexes. Sitemap has lastmod (newest product alerts lastmod 2026-10-07, e.g. hsa-alert--nutriline-bluvelle--...; sample page dated 6 Aug 2020). Isomer site; robots allows all except /search. This is illegal-health-product consumer-safety data rather than scam IOCs.

notes: official_domains hsa.gov.sg (b; SGDI). Fake social handles (fake): hsa_sg (TikTok+Instagram), hsasingaporeofficial (TikTok), hsa.gov.sg (Instagram). Legacy pages have mojibake (UTF-8 served/decoded as Latin-1 in some clients). No RSS; sitemap.xml with lastmod is the change feed. hcsa.gov.sg and healthinfo.gov.sg linked from footer (MOH portals).
